import random

def generate_test_case():
    unique_nums = random.sample(range(-5000, 5000), random.randint(1, 100))
    sorted_nums = sorted(unique_nums)
    
    n = random.randint(0, len(sorted_nums))
    
    rotated_nums = sorted_nums[n:] + sorted_nums[:n-1]
    return rotated_nums
